description: This file defines types, functions, and classes related to ARIA (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) node representations, comparison, parsing, and YAML-based snapshot parsing for accessibility testing or UI analysis within the Playwright project.

classes.name: KeyParser
classes.description: Parser class for interpreting ARIA role and attribute keys from YAML input, supporting string and regex parsing, with attribute validation.

classes.name: ParserError
classes.description: Custom error class for reporting parsing errors with position info.

methods.name: ariaNodesEqual
methods.description: Compares two AriaNode objects for equality based on role, name, properties, and cursor style.

methods.name: hasPointerCursor
methods.description: Checks if an AriaNode's box has a cursor style of 'pointer'.

methods.name: parseAriaSnapshotUnsafe
methods.description: Parses a YAML string into an AriaTemplateNode, throwing on errors.

methods.name: parseAriaSnapshot
methods.description: Parses a YAML string into an AriaTemplateNode, returning errors if any.

methods.name: findNewNode
methods.description: Finds a new AriaNode in a target tree that best matches a node from a source tree based on role and name.
